selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection moved from the now-narrower semantic resolver boundary to the transactional changeset truth boundary. ChangesetStore.stage already emits one canonical Base64 representation through Buffer.toString('base64'), but durable reload used Node's permissive Buffer.from(value,'base64'). A persisted representation such as 'Zg' therefore decoded to the same byte as canonical 'Zg==' and could still satisfy the recorded byte length and SHA-256, leaving durable before/after images textually malleable while remaining self-consistent under the existing checks.
decision_basis: The writer already defines the canonical representation, so enforcing decode->encode equality is a parity repair rather than a new serialization or cryptographic architecture.
The defect is directly falsifiable with two textual Base64 encodings that decode to identical bytes while preserving size and SHA-256.
Existing CHANGESET_PREIMAGE_CORRUPT / CHANGESET_POSTIMAGE_CORRUPT boundaries can fail closed without introducing a new status, protocol version, trust root or product shape.
changes: core/changesets.mjs now accepts a persisted non-null Base64 image only when decoding and canonical re-encoding reproduce the exact stored string.
Noncanonical durable before/after images fall through the existing corruption checks and cannot be applied or used as rollback truth.
tests/changeset-base64-canonicality.test.mjs adds postimage, preimage and intact-canonical regressions.

verification.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: Node's current Buffer.from('Zg','base64') decodes to byte 'f', re-encodes as 'Zg==', and the old size/hash-only self-consistency predicate accepts the noncanonical text.
verification.bounded_decode_replay: 4/4 PASS: old decoder accepts the noncanonical representation; the patched decoder rejects it; canonical 'Zg==' remains accepted; canonical round-trip is stable.
verification.regression_test_added: tests/changeset-base64-canonicality.test.mjs covers durable postimage/preimage rejection plus intact canonical apply behavior.

truth_boundary: Independent provenance/authentication for coherently rewritten changesets remains external/unresolved; this cycle only removes textual Base64 malleability inside the existing self-consistency boundary.
